sections.p: Through the quote form only: name, company, email, phone (optional), delivery country, description of requirements and attached drawings. No data is collected for advertising.
To review your request, prepare a quote and contact you about it.
Requests and files are stored privately and are accessible only to the Libalstal staff who prepare quotes. Hosting: {host}.

The site sets no tracking cookies. Your theme preference (light/dark) may be remembered in your browser. If Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot protection is enabled, it may process technical connection data.
You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to {privacyContact}. Legal framework: {applicableLaw}.
The LIBALSTAL logo, texts and visuals on this site belong to their respective owners. Reproduction without permission is prohibited.
The 3D visual on the home page is a conceptual illustration and does not depict a specific project.
